newsitem.title: USA: U S West Media Group names Richard Post CFO.
newsitem.headline: U S West Media Group names Richard Post CFO.

text.p: U S West Inc's U S West Media Group said it named Richard Post chief financial officer to replace Doug Holmes, who will move to Boston to help run Media Group domestic cable.
The company did not say when the moves would be effective. Officials at U S West Media were not immediately available to comment.

Post will run the company's financial services and real estate holdings. Holmes' new position will be executive vice president of finance and strategy for the domestic cable unit. He will report to the unit's chief executive, Amos Hostetter.
The company said the moves are designed to integrate the company's domestic cable properties.
